k-zero.title: ZeroSumEnjoyer (Solace) $Zero coin
k-zero.sourceSays: Posts say $Zero is a persona coin for ZeroSumEnjoyer (Solace), who went viral on FOMO after a livestream clash with trader Rasmr; others say the similar $Solace ticker is a different coin.
k-zero.reason: Nov 26 posts (01:12-05:04 UTC) describe the Solace/Rasmr livestream dispute behind the pump.fun coin, opened about 5h ago; the other coins sharing the word (Grodia, flap zero, MOTH) are unrelated and the story is unverified.
